tools.description: Answer a business question about Fernhill Grocers sales, freezers or support tickets from the governed gold model. Returns rows, the SQL that ran and a summary. Results respect the caller's region and role.
tools.name: ask_data_agent

tools.description: Run one read-only SELECT against the gold views (fact_sales, dim_store, dim_product, dim_customer, dim_date, agg_daily_sales, fact_freezer_daily, fact_ticket). Refused if it writes, reads files, touches restricted columns or exceeds the cost limit.
tools.name: run_readonly_sql

tools.description: Search the data platform documentation, data product contracts and measure definitions. Use for questions about definitions, ownership, freshness and how the platform works.
tools.name: search_docs

tools.description: Catalog entry for a table or other asset, e.g. gold.fact_sales: owner, sensitivity label, classified columns, upstream and downstream lineage.
tools.name: describe_asset

tools.description: List data products with owner, output tables, sensitivity and freshness service level.
tools.name: list_data_products
